issues.failure_explanation: Appendix A defines Lambda_t with upper-left 2x2 block (0,1;1,a_t). Its inverse has upper-left block (-a_t,1;1,0). The main-text Pi_t uses +a_t, so it is not Lambda_t^{-1}, and the stated Woodbury recursion does not compute the inverse of the estimator.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace a_t by -a_t in Pi_t, i.e., set Pi_t = Lambda_t^{-1}.
issues.overall_effect: The online confidence-region computation stated in Section 4.2 is incorrect as written.
issues.title: Wrong middle matrix in the online inverse update for the confidence region
issues.why_classification: A one-entry sign fix taken directly from the appendix derivation; the method and its guarantees are unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: The proofs rely on B_t being the averaged stochastic Hessian. They bound ||B_t - B*|| with B* = Hessian at x*, use the Hessian-noise assumption and Lipschitz continuity, and rely on the decomposition from Na et al., which is built around B*. Nothing in the paper treats a general conditioning matrix, such as AdaGrad or RMSProp preconditioners, that converges to some other limit.

failure_location.quote: Theorem \ref{sec4:thm1} does~not~\mbox{require}~$B_t$~to~\mbox{converge}~to~the true Hessian $\nabla^2 F(\tx)$, making our analysis directly applicable to conditioned SGD methods.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Remove the claim, or restate the analysis for a general limit B_t -> B with rate conditions, redefining C* and Xi* in terms of B.
issues.overall_effect: The claimed extension of the guarantees to conditioned SGD is unsupported.
issues.title: Unsupported claim that the analysis applies directly to conditioned SGD
issues.why_classification: The extension needs a reworked but analogous analysis, or it must be withdrawn; the main results are unaffected.
